pre_flight_checklist: 1. DroneBridge alici/verici guc bağlantilarini kontrol et
2. ESP32 Wi-Fi telemetry modulu baglanti durumunu dogrula (SSID: DroneBridge_ESP32)
3. Batarya hucre voltajlarini kontrol et (min: 3.7V / cell)
4. RTK GPS fix durumunu teyit et (yatay sapma < 2 cm)
6. Failsafe modlarinin ve acil motor durdurma (disarm) mekanizmasinin aktif oldugunu kontrol et

maintenance_schedule.every_10h: Inspect carbon fiber arm tubes (Ø50 mm) for cracks, and check fastener tightness (M4/M5 MRO standard). Check motor shafts for play.
maintenance_schedule.every_50h: Replace Composite props. Recalibrate MPU6050/MPU9250 IMU on auxiliary controllers (esp-fc). Check cooling fans.
